title: Stimuli.
excerpt: “… the greatest menace to our capacity for contemplation is the incessant fabrication of tawdry empty stimuli which kill the receptivity of the soul.” ― Josef Pieper, Happiness and Contemplation
body:
“… the greatest menace to our capacity for contemplation is the incessant fabrication of tawdry empty stimuli which kill the receptivity of the soul.”

― Josef Pieper, Happiness and Contemplation
